subject: Staffing gate: request to open backfill for Sr. Inference Engineer
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Staffing gate: request to open backfill — Sr. Inference Engineer

Hi Ava,

We need a formal go/no-go to open a backfill for the Sr. Inference Engineer on Platform. The role owner is on an internal transfer effective mid-Jan and the hiring manager (Rishi) has asked us to start pipelining immediately to meet Q2 capacity. Summary below: 

- Role: Sr. Inference Engineer (IC4)
- Team: Serving runtime / Model Ops
- Justification: backfill to maintain throughput SLAs for low-latency production workloads; replacement for internal transfer
- Target start: March 2027
- Proposed level: IC4 (benchmark comp band attached)

Can you confirm we have headcount approval to post and interview, or let me know any gating questions before we open the req? I attached the JD and a candidate resume we're considering via a referral — we can either screen or hold until req is live.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Talent Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: JD_Sr_Inference_ENG.pdf]
[Attachment: candidate_resume_jordan.pdf]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing gate: request to open backfill — Sr. Inference Engineer

Thanks for the note, Marissa. Quick clarifying items before I greenlight posting: 

1) Budget/level confirmation: Is IC4 within the current team budget or do we need a comp exception? Please include suggested band and target comp.
2) Interview panel: proposed interviewers and estimated calendar slots (we're tight in Dec).
3) Candidate pipeline approach: do you want us to screen the referral now (informal) or wait until req is live?

Ben — can you propose a condensed 3-stage interview plan (screen -> take-home -> panel) and estimated turnaround time so we can avoid a long lag?

If those are all ok I can approve opening the req this week.

Ava

--
Ava Chen
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing gate: request to open backfill — Sr. Inference Engineer

Thanks — proposed plan below. I'm happy to run this pipeline once we have posting approval.

Recruiting plan (condensed):
- Stage 1: 30-min recruiter screen (culture + technical breadth) — target turnaround 3 business days
- Stage 2: 60-min take-home / coding exercise with focused inference problem — 5 business days grading window
- Stage 3: 90-min onsite panel (two runtime engineers + one infra PM + hiring manager) — target within 7 business days of take-home pass

Proposed interviewers: Rishi Malhotra (hiring mgr), Markus Klein (runtime lead), Evelyn Hart (infra), + one cross-team senior engineer to assess scale experience.

Comp: IC4 fits the hiring plan; comp band midpoint $210k (base) with total comp range 180k-270k depending on experience. If Rishi wants to exceed midpoint we will need a recruiting budget exception approved.

On the referral candidate (Jordan Lee): I reviewed the resume attached — strong latency-focused experience and distributed systems background. We can do an early recruiter screen and, if positive, schedule the take-home contingent on posting. That allows us to move faster.

Links: posting draft -> https://redwood.airtable.com/recs/REQ-789
HubSpot candidate card -> https://hubspot.company/contact/CONTACT-333

I'll prepare the requisition draft and the take-home prompt once you confirm.

- Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Staffing gate: request to open backfill — Sr. Inference Engineer

Ava — greenlight to open the req and begin screening the referral. 

Notes and approvals: 
- Headcount: approved to post (no additional headcount request required).
- Comp: IC4 band confirmed; hiring manager may use up to midpoint without extra approval. Exceptions above midpoint require documented business case.
- Timeline: recruiting should follow Ben's condensed plan; prioritize candidate screens to hit Q2 hires.

Ben — please post the req (REQ-789), kick off the recruiter screen with Jordan, and loop Rishi. Attach the take-home by EOW. I'll review any comp exceptions if they arise.

Thanks all — let's keep updates in the Airtable posting.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Talent Programs
Redwood Inference
